description: Represents a scheduler-specific resource snapshot. Use ToResource and FromResource to bridge to the shared TmResource model.

members.name: Color
members.description: CSS color value for the resource.

members.name: ResourceType
members.description: Optional resource type, for example person, team, room, or equipment.

members.name: GroupId
members.description: Optional group identifier for nested grouping.

members.name: SourceKey
members.description: Optional provider/source discriminator for applications with multiple resource sources.

members.name: TenantId
members.description: Optional tenant, workspace, or application scope identifier.

members.name: ToResource
members.description: Creates a shared resource snapshot from this scheduler resource.

members.name: FromResource
members.description: Creates a scheduler resource snapshot from a shared resource model.
